ios.desc:
Welcome to your secret pocket omikuji.

Whenever you’re bored, daydreaming, or feeling a little flutter in your heart, slip in and hide away for a while.

【 Omikuji 】A sweet little ritual of wonder: tilt toward morning light to reveal hidden ink, gently sway your phone to blow the mist away, warm the slip with your fingertips, or flip your phone face-down for the deity’s red seal! Drew bad luck? No worries—slide it up and tie it to the shrine's cord rack, letting worries scatter into the breeze.

【 Secret Courtyard 】Pure spring water, sacred sake, white rice, sweet dango... leave a little treat on the stone altar. Who will tiptoe in tonight? While you sleep, the Shrine Cat stretches and knocks down a coin dusted with cat fur; the shy Tanuki puffs into white smoke, leaving behind an origami frog. Follow the nocturnal footsteps and collect rare spirit keepsakes.

【 Little Fox Letters 】A few curious foxes are lounging by the torii gate: the Clear-Mind Deity, the Procrastinator, the Soft-Hearted, the Wanderer, the Night Owl... Pick one, pack a soft little satchel, and watch it trot into the misty mountains to fetch an omamori charm from afar—along with a letter spilling all the cozy shrine gossip along the way.

Wonder what the spirits have to say today?
